title: Drag and Drop
summary: Dragging an asset onto a slot, reordering a list, moving an object to another parent in a tree - ImGui's drag and drop works between any two items with a typed **payload**. This lesson covers sources, targets, payload types, reordering a list by dragging, and re-parenting in a tree without creating loops.
ideas:
- Make assets draggable onto a texture slot in an inspector.
- Make a layer list reorderable by dragging.
- Make scene objects re-parentable by dragging in the tree, refusing drops that would create a loop.

cards.q: What does SetDragDropPayload do with the data you pass?
cards.a: It copies it, so the payload is safe even if the source changes, as long as it holds values such as ids rather than pointers.
On the frame the mouse button is released over the target with a payload of the accepted type.

cards.q: What check must re-parenting by drag and drop make?
cards.a: That the new parent is not the dragged node itself or any of its descendants.
